scope: Current official operator page confirms ad-hoc charging without registration via QR/NFC and links a price sheet, but the accessible numeric sheet states an effective date of 1 February 2023. That value is retained only as historical evidence and is not promoted to a 2026 tariff.
policy: Fail closed for current numeric pricing until an official current price sheet or station-level checkout payload is obtained. Do not assume e-laden member tariffs are uniform across operators.
